title: Wait for CI run ID
command: cd /Users/xuyingzhou/Project/study-node-ts/playwright-user-sys && sleep 30 && gh run list --limit 1 --json databaseId,status --jq '.[0].databaseId' 2>&1

title: Watch CI and deploy manager
command: cd /Users/xuyingzhou/Project/study-node-ts/playwright-user-sys && RUN_ID=$(gh run list --limit 1 --json databaseId --jq '.[0].databaseId') && echo "Watching run $RUN_ID" && gh run watch $RUN_ID --exit-status 2>&1 && echo "=== CI DONE ===" && ssh jkj "docker pull ghcr.io/dyyz1993/playwright-user-sys-manager:latest && cd /data/docker/playwright-user-sys/docker && docker compose -f docker-compose.prod.yml up -d manager" 2>&1
